hdbscan.py.summary: For algorithm kd_tree, fit calls _hdbscan_prims. It obtains k-neighbor core distances, builds the MST, then assigns the private linkage before invoking condensation and cluster selection.

budget_risk.comparison_scope: quality diagnostics only; no 100 ms/full-tour timing contract is qualified by this campaign
budget_risk.interpretation: The 1050-second total includes five native calls, projection analysis and twenty official fits. No timing bound has been measured for this protocol; the source-derived quadratic work can cause censoring. Partial or timed-out execution cannot qualify completion.

static_work.formula: Per finite n-site fit: n*(n-1)/2 calls to dist_metric.dist. Total =len(orders)*sum(n*(n-1)/2).
static_work.status: source-derived work count; not measured time or performance prediction
